# Azure Data Connectors

Use installed `azdata` v4, not a skill-local package. Read the
[canonical guide](../../../libraries/azure-data-connectors/docs/skills/azure-data-connectors.md)
for public requests/results, service profiles, errors, bounds, lifecycle and
retained operational findings. Host authorization and explicit native operator
authority remain separate. This entry contains no runtime or MCP server and grants
no credentials, data access, mutation, provisioning or model calls.
